items.signal_prefix: Infineon IR (Daniel Gyory, Team Lead Investor Relations): of the order backlog

set.signal: Infineon IR (Daniel Gyory, Team Lead Investor Relations): about two-thirds of the order backlog (the KPI disclosed quarterly, as per the last quarter close), roughly EUR 20 billion, is due in the next 12 months; AI is 'a good portion' of it but the split has never been disclosed. AI design cycles give visibility of roughly one to two years, so the AI backlog is concentrated more on the short term, while some automotive customers order two, three years ahead. He cautioned that the backlog is not revenue guidance and may include double ordering or orders for products without enough capacity, but said he would not see a reason why this number should go down or weaken significantly.
